app_type: ATC Tool & Flight Radar Dashboard (Desktop-First, Francophone MSFS Community)
design_archetype: ARCHETYPE 4: SWISS & TACTICAL ATC RADAR (High-Contrast, Pure Clarity, Flight Deck Aesthetics)

rules: Use JetBrains Mono for all ATC callsigns, squawk codes, flight levels, speed, coordinates, airport ICAO codes, and METAR/TAF readouts.
Headings in Geist with font-semibold or font-bold, tracking-tight.
Uppercase micro-labels (0.75rem / 12px) with tracking-wider for technical telemetry fields.

entry_surfaces./: dark tactical radar dashboard — top glass bar with sync/status and logo slot, left flights sidebar, center Leaflet radar map with Carto Dark tiles, right expandable flight details/telemetry drawer
entry_surfaces./airports: tactical airport charts & taxiway viewer — list of supported hubs (LFPG, LSGG with FICTIF badges), interactive runway/taxiway diagram and taxi route editor
entry_surfaces./simbrief: flight plan import workbench — OFP XML/JSON parser with preview, route waypoints breakdown and 1-click active flight submission
entry_surfaces./history: flight log archives — high-density data table with filters by pilot, callsign, phase, and date with replay/export options
entry_surfaces./admin: control tower administration — user role management (Pilote, ATC, Admin), active flights master override, and live audit log stream
entry_surfaces./login: tactical flight crew auth — callsign/email credentials modal with simulator community notices
entry_surfaces./register: flight crew registration — pilot onboarding with Discord handle & simulator ID verification

visual_enhancers.radar_grid: Subtle 10% opacity concentric range rings (10nm, 20nm, 40nm) and crosshair grid on the radar canvas.
visual_enhancers.simulated_warning_pill: Prominent, persistent amber tag 'POSITIONS & DONNÉES SIMULÉES / ESTIMÉES' with pulsing subtle indicator.
visual_enhancers.leaflet_tiles: CARTO Dark Matter (https://{s}.basemaps.cartocdn.com/dark_all/{z}/{x}/{y}{r}.png) with custom dark canvas pane styling.
visual_enhancers.aircraft_icons: SVG chevron/airplane symbols dynamically rotated by heading (track), color-coded by flight phase with leader lines to ATC flight data blocks (Callsign, FL, Ground Speed, Destination).
visual_enhancers.tactical_borders: 1px solid #1E293B with sharp 4px or 6px radius for that true Eurocat/TopSky ATC radar hardware appearance.

main_radar_layout.header: h-12 border-b border-border bg-background/95 flex items-center justify-between px-4 z-30
main_radar_layout.left_sidebar: w-80 lg:w-96 flex-shrink-0 border-r border-border bg-card flex flex-col h-[calc(100vh-3rem)] overflow-hidden
main_radar_layout.right_drawer: w-88 lg:w-96 flex-shrink-0 border-l border-border bg-card flex flex-col h-[calc(100vh-3rem)] overflow-y-auto

header.description: Top bar containing SkyCommunity logo slot, frequency/server status indicator, simulator time (UTC / Zulu), active flights counter, quick phase filter, user role pill (Pilote/ATC/Admin), and quick actions (SimBrief Import, Taxi Editor).

radar_map.description: Leaflet map with CARTO Dark Matter tiles. Renders active flights with rotation, flight trails, FIR boundaries, airport runways/taxiways (LFPG, LSGG), waypoints, and interactive click-to-select.

flight_list.description: Dense tabular/card list of active flights with phase badges, search by callsign/pilot, filter by phase, squawk code, and origin/destination.

flight_details_drawer.description: ATC strip & Flight Plan detail view with phase action selector (Préparation -> Repoussage -> Roulage -> Point d'attente -> Décollage -> En Route -> Approche -> Atterrissage -> Roulage Arrivée -> Parking -> Terminé), altitude/speed graph, SimBrief OFP details, route waypoints, and history timeline.

taxi_route_editor.description: Interactive airport taxi route planner on top of airport diagram (LFPG/LSGG), letting ATC or Pilots click taxiway nodes/segments (A, B, T1, Hold Short 26L) and transmit progressive taxi clearances.

simbrief_importer.description: SimBrief username/OFP fetch tool with route preview, fuel/payload calculation, cruising altitude, alternate airport, and 1-click radar flight creation.

airport_hub_view.description: Airport information dashboard for LFPG and LSGG with runway configurations, current simulated ATIS/METAR, parked/departing aircraft lists, and prominent 'DONNÉES FICTIVES' labels.

motion.pulsing_alerts: animate-pulse on squawk 7700/7600 emergencies or holding point alerts
motion.drawer_slide: Smooth slide-in transition for flight details and tools

accessibility.contrast_compliance: All telemetry, labels and table headers verified > 4.5:1 against #0B111E and #111827.
accessibility.colorblind_safety: Flight phases use distinct badges with text labels and icon shapes in addition to color coding.
accessibility.keyboard_shortcuts: ESC closes drawers, space recenters map on selected aircraft, numbers 1-9 switch radar filters.
accessibility.data_testids: All interactive buttons, flight list items, phase triggers, and inputs must have data-testid attributes.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Install Leaflet and types: cd /app/frontend && yarn add leaflet @types/leaflet leaflet-rotatedmarker
2. Configure dark theme in /app/frontend/src/index.css with Geist and JetBrains Mono variable fonts. Set dark class on html tag.
3. Seed realistic MSFS French flights (e.g. AFR452, EZS188, TVF22A, HOP14DF) with realistic routes between LFPG, LSGG, LFMN, LFBO, LFLL with simulated altitudes and phases.
4. Ensure every simulated position and airport diagram is explicitly stamped with 'SIMULÉ / ESTIMÉ' and 'DONNÉES FICTIVES' in compliance with flight community safety rules.
5. Provide intuitive ATC phase action buttons in the FlightDetailsDrawer allowing pilots/ATC to step through the 13 defined flight phases.

6. Include complete role support: 'Pilote' (can update own flight), 'ATC' (can update any flight & issue taxi routes), 'Admin' (can manage users, reset radar, purge flights, inspect audit log). Provide a quick role switcher for testing.
7. Build SimBrief XML/JSON import modal with instant preview and pre-fill capabilities.
8. Build Taxi Route Editor on airport diagram allowing clickable taxiway waypoints and visual path highlights.
